verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall script validates native bindings and installs @swc/wasm as fallback.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to identify target package name
behaviors.analysis: Script reads package.json via path.resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD, 'package.json') to verify if it is @swc/core or @swc/workspace.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate dependency validation; no data exfiltration.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install command to install @swc/wasm fallback
behaviors.analysis: Executes npm install --no-save ... @swc/wasm@version to ensure native bindings are available.
behaviors.impact: Standard post-install behavior for optional native dependencies.

behaviors.analysis: Uses child_process.execSync for npm install and ldd --version checks; no command injection patterns detected.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate system interaction for dependency resolution.

decision.label: benign
reasons: Install path not fully reviewed; human review required
